sources.title: Local Python Integration | pipecat-ai/smart-turn | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers direct integration of the Smart Turn model into Python applications using the core inference components. Local Python integration provides the most direct access to the Smart Turn v3 model, allowing developers to embed turn detection capabilities directly into their applications without external dependencies or cloud services.
